verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਹੁਇ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਗੰਮਿਤਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਕਾਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਸੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan saran man bach kram hui ikatr ga(n)mitaa tirakaal tirabhavan sudh paiee hai ||

en.bdb: When a Guru-conscious person achieves harmony with his mind, words and actions, and by the blessings of the refuge of True Guru, he acquires knowledge of times and the three worlds.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਾਧਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਕਥਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਨਿਰੰਤਰੀ ਜਤਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sahaj samaadh saadh agam agaadh kathaa a(n)tar dhisa(n)tar nira(n)taree jataiee hai ||

en.bdb: By practicing on Naam, a Guru-conscious person lives in a state of equipoise. Any description of that state is beyond our comprehension. It is indescribable. By dint of that state, he becomes aware of all that is happening in every nook and corner of the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਪਿੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੋਹੰ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd pi(n)dd praan praanapat gat gur sikh sa(n)dh mile soha(n) liv laiee hai ||

en.bdb: By the union of Guru and Sikh, the seeker feels the presence of the Lord of Cosmos in his body and his life-giving support; and when he achieves oneness with God, he remains engrossed in the memory of Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਪਨ ਦਰਸ ਅਉ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਧਨਿ ਜੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਸੂਤ ਏਕੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਿਟਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੪੭॥
verses.translit_en: dharapan dharas aau ja(n)tr dhan ja(n)tree bidh ot pot soot ekai dhubidhaa miTaiee hai ||47||

en.bdb: As the mirror and image in it, music and the musical instrument, waft and woof of a cloth are all part of each other and inseparable, so does the Guru-conscious person becomes one with God and is freed of all doubts of duality. (47)
